egin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch5:5-1↗ prop:difference-tensor

Let $(M,g)$ be a Riemannian or pseudo-Riemannian manifold, and let $ abla $ be its Levi-Civita connection. Suppose $ ilde{ abla }$ is another connection on $TM$ and $D$ is the difference tensor between $ abla $ and $ ilde{ abla }$ (Prop. 4.13). Let $D^ lat $ denote the covariant 3-tensor field defined by $D^ lat (X,Y,Z) = \langle D(X,Y),Z angle $. Show that $ ilde{ abla }$ is compatible with $g$ if and only if $D^ lat $ is antisymmetric in its last two arguments: $D^ lat (X,Y,Z) = -D^ lat (X,Z,Y)$ for all $X,Y,Z \in \mathfrak {X}(M)$. Conclude that on every Riemannian or pseudo-Riemannian manifold of dimension at least 2, the space of metric connections is an infinite-dimensional affine space. (Used on p. 121.) \end{exercise}
